_comment: Per-region Era I look (welt akt4): its own overworld atlas (relative to art/eraN/) and its own four screen inks, darkest to lightest. Each ink stays in the same luminance quarter as the shared Era I inks so the palette filter keeps four clean tones. Regions not listed use the shared atlas and EraManager.INK_PALETTE. Atlas made by tools/art/gen_tiles_solenne.py.
